homepageMessage: The vendor training is scheduled from Monday to Saturday from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM. If any vendor needs it, please connect using the link given below, on the specified time. All bidders are advised to submit their bids, well ahead of the stipulated bid submission close date and time, to avoid any last-minute platform issues like connectivity, network traffic, etc. Kindly note that upon uploading of any addendum/corrigendum for any tender by the department, the prior submitted bids may be deleted. Accordingly, bidders should re-submit their bids if required, after a corrigendum is published for that tender. Registration of all new bidders will happen only through a valid Class III DSC, with immediate effect. Existing bidders using Class II DSC can use it till the expiry of their DSC, after that they also have to use a valid Class III DSC for renewal. For any assistance, please contact Helpdesk on 1800 572 6571 (toll-free). Please note that the given mobile number (9939035696) does not belong to eProc2 helpdesk or BELTRON. It is advised to contact only through the toll-free helpdesk number as mentioned in the portal. If any payment transactions received through E-payment Gateway regarding Registration Fee / Tender Fee / Tender Processing Fee /EMD, which need to be returned/refunded, then the amount without the Applicable charges, Payment Gateway charges etc., shall be returned to vendor in respective source account by the application itself, within 15 days, after due verification of double / duplicate/incorrect payment. Vendor hereby agrees that he / she will not approach their bank for disputes / chargeback claims and contact to merchant.
